# Every stage dumps in both structural formats, with and without --omit. Three
# things stopped one or another:
#
# - --omit zeroed a field of a struct held by value in an interface, which is
#   not settable through it, and panicked at the first one: every stage.
# - spew prints a shared pointer once per path to it, so from the checked
#   stage on, the back-pointers a package holds -- a name's symbol, a type's
#   declaration -- printed the library again from every name and the dump
#   never finished. spew is handed the tree json writes.
# - json met a cycle at the checked stage through an import's package and
#   the package's symbol table, which a dump names rather than writes.
#
# --omit used to zero the fields in place, which in-process wrote into the
# library IR and the parsed ASTs every check shares, so the second checked
# dump here failed its own check: the checked stage is dumped four times.

sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew main.sngl
stdout 'main.sngl:5:1'
sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout 'Name: \(string\) \(len=4\) "main"'
! stdout 'main.sngl:5:1'
sngl dump --stage parsed --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "main"'

sngl dump --stage checked --format spew main.sngl
stdout 'Name: \(string\) \(len=4\) "main"'
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout 'Name: \(string\) \(len=4\) "main"'
sngl dump --stage checked --format json main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "main"'
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "main"'

sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format spew --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout 'ast.Document'
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Stmts"'

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const greeting = "hi"

component main node {
    var n = 0
    button(text="{greeting} {n}", @click { n += 1 })
}

window {
    main
}
